description: A composite process-route figure (no panel letters printed) built from three schematic elements, with one element repeated at larger scale. Left: a blue 3-D rectangular block dimensioned "100 mm × 100 mm", followed by a yellow arrow to four blue plates labelled "Thickness: 1.5mm", "Thickness: 2.0mm", "Thickness: 3.5mm" and "Thickness: 10.0mm". Middle: a schematic profile with axis labels "Temperature (°C)" (vertical) and "Time (h)" (horizontal) and no numeric tick values; a straight segment rises to a plateau annotated "1000°C" and "1h", after which a steep descending line is labelled "water quenching". Right: a dashed-border box titled in red "Circulation process" containing two labelled sub-schematics. "Cryogenic Rolling" shows two red rolls with green counter-rotation arrows above and below a blue plate that travels along a dashed "Rolling direction" arrow between two "working roll" arrows; an inset thumbnail shows the plate thinning. "Cryogenic treatment" shows an open box into which a blue plate is immersed, annotated "liquid nitrogen immersing process". Blue text inside the box states "Final Circulation: thickness reduction reached 30%, 50%, 70%, and 90%, respectively". Yellow arrows link the elements in sequence. The whole figure defines the sample condition: block → hot/warm rolled plates of four thicknesses → 1000°C/1h + water quenching → repeated liquid-nitrogen immersion with cryogenic rolling to 30-90% thickness reduction.

subfigures.description: 3-D schematic of a blue block labelled "100 mm × 100 mm", with a yellow arrow pointing to four blue plates labelled "Thickness: 1.5mm", "Thickness: 2.0mm", "Thickness: 3.5mm" and "Thickness: 10.0mm", i.e. the as-received billet and the plate thicknesses obtained by rolling.
Temperature (°C) versus Time (h) schematic (both axes labelled, no numeric ticks): linear ramp to a plateau annotated "1000°C" and "1h", then a steep branch labelled "water quenching".

Dashed box titled "Circulation process" containing (i) "Cryogenic Rolling" — two red rolls with green counter-rotation arrows and "working roll" arrows around a blue plate moving along the dashed "Rolling direction" arrow — and (ii) "Cryogenic treatment" — an open box with a blue plate and the annotation "liquid nitrogen immersing process". Blue text: "Final Circulation: thickness reduction reached 30%, 50%, 70%, and 90%, respectively".

A larger-scale repetition of the same rolling/cryogenic-treatment content as the right panel (red rolls, blue plate, arrows labelled "working roll" and "Rolling direction", "Cryogenic Rolling", "Cryogenic treatment", "liquid nitrogen immersing process"), without the dashed frame and without the "Final Circulation" text.

observations.observation: The figure is composite: it mixes a sample-geometry/plate-thickness schematic, a temperature-time processing profile, and a two-part circulation-process schematic.

A blue rectangular block is dimensioned "100 mm × 100 mm" and is linked by a yellow arrow to four plate diagrams labelled "Thickness: 1.5mm", "Thickness: 2.0mm", "Thickness: 3.5mm" and "Thickness: 10.0mm".
The temperature-time schematic shows a ramp to a plateau annotated "1000°C" and "1h", followed by a steep cooling branch labelled "water quenching"; neither axis carries numeric tick values.
The circulation-process box is drawn with a dashed border, is titled in red "Circulation process", and contains one sub-panel labelled "Cryogenic Rolling" and one labelled "Cryogenic treatment".

In the "Cryogenic Rolling" sub-panel two red rolls with green counter-rotation arrows sandwich a blue plate that passes along a dashed "Rolling direction" arrow between two pointers labelled "working roll".
The "Cryogenic treatment" sub-panel depicts an open container with a blue plate being immersed, annotated "liquid nitrogen immersing process".
Blue text inside the circulation box reads "Final Circulation: thickness reduction reached 30%, 50%, 70%, and 90%, respectively".

Curved yellow arrows connect the elements in sequence, encoding the processing order block → rolled plates → cryogenic circulation, and a further arrow leads back from the liquid-nitrogen bath into the rolling step.

The last image in the group repeats the cryogenic-rolling and cryogenic-treatment schematics at larger scale without the dashed frame or the "Final Circulation" text, i.e. it is an enlargement rather than a distinct panel.
The caption states the figure is a schematic diagram of the heat treatment process, cryogenic treatment, and CR.

The citing text states that corresponding samples were produced by progressively grinding and polishing along the rolling direction (RD) and etched with hydrochloric acid (100 mL), alcohol (100 mL) and copper chloride (5 g), linking the figure's RD arrow to the metallographic preparation.
